## Description and Rationale

I am a PhD researcher at the German Aerospace Center, Department of Controller Assistance. While my current research focus is different from surface management, I have a keen interest in using computer science to improve the efficiency of air traffic control and airport operations. 
I am participating in the PRC challenge in my own time to improve my programming and machine learning skills and to have a fun challenge with real operational data.

## Details

* Type: Academia, Independent
* Country: Germany
* Number of team members: 1
